offers.title: Campaign Manager - France
offers.description:
As part of our Field Marketing team, you’ll plan, execute and report on global and regional campaigns that drive pipeline growth. For global campaigns, you own the French activation, turning global messaging into a local narrative that lands with our audience. For local campaigns, you align with local leadership and GTM priorities to generate demand and commercial impact. You’ll bring campaigns to life across email, webinars, social and events, using data to keep messaging relevant.

Your 12-Month Journey
